note: Model lists read from the M-EFCS 3.7.1413 dropdowns (index = position, DS/AMP/CAB names carry their 1-based number); knob names from the editor's panel; defaults read from the pedal (firmware V73) right after selecting the model. Speed/Time knobs are stored x10 / in ms (Speed 2.5 = 25, Time 0.5 s = 500); negative values are int16.
